title: Anthropic S-1 claims it may "imminently meet" its RSI threshold and may fail to identify "significant acceleration" in its development until after it's occurred (Julie Bort/TechCrunch)
summary: Julie Bort / TechCrunch: Anthropic S-1 claims it may “imminently meet” its RSI threshold and may fail to identify “significant acceleration” in its development until after it's occurred — While much attention has focused on the updated financials Anthropic revealed in its revised S-1A on Monday …
contentText:
Julie Bort / TechCrunch :

Anthropic S-1 claims it may “imminently meet” its RSI threshold and may fail to identify “significant acceleration” in its development until after it's occurred   —  While much attention has focused on the updated financials Anthropic revealed in its revised S-1A on Monday …
